opening.argument: The video presents a straightforward Netflix gift-card redemption tutorial, centered on entering an existing PIN or code into a Netflix account. Its title identifies the subject as redeeming a Netflix gift-card code, and the speaker gives the direct instruction, “you want to enter your PIN or code.” The account page then shows the redemption field with an entered code and confirms that “$25 gift card has been applied to your account,” consistent with the demonstrated process. The speaker also expressly distinguishes the tutorial from obtaining free gift cards, stating, “this is not a video about how to get free Netflix gift cards.” Although a separate app is mentioned, that reference is qualified and nonspecific, with no stated requirement to participate and no promised deceptive benefit.
